name: Zao Quasi-National Park
description: Quasi-national park of the Zao mountains: the emerald Okama crater lake, the 'snow monsters' of winter and the hot-spring plateaus on the Miyagi-Yamagata border.
notes: Managed by Miyagi. The Zao ropeway reaches the crater rim and ski slopes.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
